violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE. PIC’S CERTIFICATION EXPIRED IN 2025.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC IS SCHEDULED TO RETAKE A CFM EXAM ON THE 22ND. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION AND PROVIDE PROOF OF CERTIFICATION BY THE 28TH OF SEPTEMBER TO THE EHS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED PRECOOKED PASTA AT 46-49F, PRECOOKED FRIED CHICKEN AT 46-48F, AND PRECOOKED FRIED CHICKEN #2 AT 46-47F IN THE THREE-DOOR PREP- TOP. OBSERVED THE BOTTOM RIGHT SIDE PORTION OF THE COOLER WITH MUCH AIR FLOW.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PIC WILL ENSURE THE COOLER IS REPAIRED/ADJUSTED BY A TECHNICIAN.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED BOTTOM RIGHT SIDE OF THE THREE-DOOR PREP TOP AT 42F AND A FEW TCS FOODS NOT COLD HOLDING PROPERLY. THE REST OF THE COOLER WAS OBSERVED AT 39F AND TCS FOODS WERE COLD HOLDING PROPERLY. OBSERVED THE QUATERNARY AMMONIA DISPENSER DISPENSING SANITIZER AT TOO HIGH OF A CONCENTRATION (400PPM).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC WILL ENSURE THE ESTABLISHMENT MONITORS THE COOLER TEMPERATURE AND A TECHNICIAN REPAIRS/ADJUSTS THE COOLER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. PLEASE PROVIDE PROOF OF CORRECTION TO THE EHS BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF ARE TESTING THE QUATERNARY AMMONIA CONCENTRATION AND ADDING WATER TO THE SANITIZER FOR THE TIME- BEING. PLEASE ENSURE THE DISPENSER IS ADJUSTED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: DOK Having a CFM Present
violations.corrective_action: A CFM is required at all operating hours.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.
